# Exhibit On Superior

> Exhibit On Superior is a 298-unit luxury apartment community at 165 W Superior St in Chicago's River North neighborhood. It offers studio, convertible, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments with a professional on-site management team.
> Every page has a clean Markdown twin: append `.md` to its URL (e.g. https://www.rentatexhibit.com/amenities.md; homepage: https://www.rentatexhibit.com/index.md), or request any page with `Accept: text/markdown`. Full page catalog with Markdown links: https://www.rentatexhibit.com/llms-full.txt

## Primary Information

- [Property Overview](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/): Official property overview, address, contact information, apartment types, and management information.
- [Available Apartments & Floor Plans](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/available-units): Current unit availability, rents, floor plans, and availability dates.
- [Floor Plans](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/floor-plans): 34 distinct floor-plan layouts with plan sheets, square footage, floor ranges, and balcony details.
- [Virtual Tour](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/virtual-tour): Matterport 3D tours and video walkthroughs of the building and apartments.
- [Amenities](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/amenities): Apartment and community amenities.
- [Fees & Leasing Costs](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/fees): Application fees, utility bundle, parking, storage, and other charges.
- [Pet Policy](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/pet-friendly): Pet rules, fees, and restrictions.
- [Neighborhood](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/neighborhood): River North location, transportation, shopping, and dining.
- [Apartment Guide](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/apartment-guide): Layouts, finishes, balconies, in-unit laundry, and views by floor range.
- [Application Guide](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/application-guide): Online application process, credit requirements, guarantors, and lease terms.
- [Parking & Transportation](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/parking-transportation): On-site garage, EV charging, bike storage, and CTA access.
- [Resident Reviews](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/reviews): Verified resident reviews from Google.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/faq): Leasing, touring, parking, utilities, and building information.
- [Contact Us](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/contact-us): Leasing office phone, email, address, and hours.
- [Schedule a Tour](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/schedule-a-tour): Book an in-person or virtual tour.
- [About](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/about): Building history, management, and community overview.
- [Map & Directions](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/map-directions): Driving and transit directions to 165 W Superior St.
